events.body:
## Context

In `src/pages/submit.html`, `#msg` has no live region, and the submit handler calls `res.json()` before checking `res.ok`, so a plain-text 404 or an HTML 5xx shows "Unexpected token...".

## What to do

1. Add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` to the message container; use `role="alert"` for errors.
2. Check `res.ok` and the content type before parsing; fall back to a friendly message.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Success and error messages are announced
- [ ] A mocked 502 HTML response shows a readable error

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-zero && npx wrangler dev   # override /submit in DevTools
```
